The Noosphere

A foldable codex of 176 Eldritch Invocations, three Otherworldly Patrons, and the design ledger that holds them honest.

"The page does not always know what it carries. Press a circle to make it speak."

Book I

Patrons

Three patrons are catalogued here: appetite and fracture, schedule and return, and ritualized perfection through needlework and occult craft.
▸
Patron · Demogorgon

The Two-Headed Prince

Dual-mind chassis — every feature reads or rewrites whether your alter ego is Suppressed or Manifested.
▸
Otherworldly Patron

Demogorgon, the Two-Headed Prince

A pact written in two hands at once. One head names every threat; the other promises every survival. You ride the seam between them, and the seam learns your name.

1st levelExpanded Spell List

Expanded Spell List

The two-headed prince adds his preferred dominations to your spell list.

LevelSpell
1stCommand
1stCompelled Duel
2ndTasha's Mind Whip
2ndBlur
3rdHaste
3rdBlink
4thConfusion
4thFreedom of Movement
5thGeas
5thTelekinesis
1st levelFocus-chassis

Fractured Psyche

Two minds wear one skull; the floor between them keeps shifting.

You have two alter egos: Manifested and Suppressed. As a Bonus Action on your turn, you can start concentrating (as if concentrating on a spell). While you are concentrating in this way, your alter ego is Suppressed; otherwise, it is Manifested.
1st levelSame-beat cost

Psychic Breach

When their will splinters, yours leans through the crack.

When a creature fails a saving throw against one of your spells, and that saving throw adds its Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier, you can expend one Hit Die and roll it, producing one of the following effects according to your current state. When you reach 10th level in this class, you can expend two Hit Dice and roll them instead.

Manifested. You gain temporary hit points equal to the number rolled.
Suppressed. The creature takes psychic damage equal to the number rolled.
1st levelSpell-list adapter

Cult Indoctrination

A feature of the two-headed pact.

You learn the true strike cantrip and one cantrip of your choice from mind sliver or vicious mockery. These cantrips count as warlock cantrips for you and don't count against your number of cantrips known.
6th levelSocial pressure

Mental Schemer

A feature of the two-headed pact.

You learn one spell of your choice: charm person or cause fear. It doesn't count against your number of spells known. Additionally, you can take the Influence action as a bonus action.
10th levelMental evasion

Ragged Bastion

A feature of the two-headed pact.

When you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, you can use your reaction to expend one Hit Die and roll it, adding the number rolled to the saving throw, potentially turning the failure into a success. If you succeed on the saving throw in this way, damage you take from that effect until the end of the turn doesn't break your concentration.
14th levelState inversion

Pandemonium of Two Heads

A feature of the two-headed pact.

As an Action, you can project your presence into the minds of all creatures within 30 feet of you until the end of your next turn. While your alter ego is Manifested, any creature within 30 feet of you that is frightened of you always knows your exact location, and you always know its exact location. While your alter ego is Suppressed, any creature within 30 feet of you that is charmed by you cannot perceive you with any of their senses.
Patron · The Machine

The Clockwork Cosmos

A patron of exact returns — wheels, ledgers, inertia, and the cost of perfect timing.
▸
Otherworldly Patron

The Machine, Cosmic Clockwork

Not a god so much as a schedule. The Machine offers no mercy and no omen; it grants cadence, accounting, and the terrible serenity of a wheel that never misses its tooth.

1st levelExpanded Spell List

Expanded Spell List

Each spell is a tooth on the wheel.

LevelSpell
1stAbsorb Elements
1stGrease
2ndFind Traps
2ndTasha's Wristpocket
3rdElemental Weapon
3rdTiny Servant
4thStoneskin
4thFabricate
5thAnimate Objects
5thCreation
1st levelSpecialty

Graduated Technomancer

Choose your discipline within the great engine.

At 1st level, choose one of the following specialties:

Electrics. You gain proficiency with tinker's tools, and you learn the shocking grasp cantrip. It counts as a warlock cantrip for you and doesn't count against your number of cantrips known.

Mechanics. You gain proficiency with smith's tools, and you learn the mending and prestidigitation cantrips. They count as warlock cantrips for you and don't count against your number of cantrips known.
6th levelResource recursion

Ledger Adjustment

The Machine never refunds a debt; it merely schedules its return.

When you finish a short rest, you can inscribe one expended warlock spell slot on the Machine's ledger. Before you finish a long rest, when you cast a warlock spell, you can erase one inscribed slot to treat that casting as though the slot were one level higher than normal, to a maximum of 5th level. You can keep no more than three inscribed slots on the ledger at one time, and all remaining entries vanish when you finish a long rest.
10th levelTurn scheduling

Cosmic Latency

The wheel can force a moment to wait for its proper tooth.

When a creature you can see within 60 feet would make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction to delay that roll until the start of its next turn. During the delay, the creature can't take reactions, and if it willingly moves more than 10 feet before the delayed roll resolves, the roll is lost. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
14th levelPredestination engine

Final Tooth

For one round, the wheel stops guessing and simply remembers.

As an action, you lock the next round into the Machine's preferred sequence. Until the end of your next turn, once on each creature's turn, you can replace one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made by a creature you can see within 60 feet with a result of 10 before modifiers. A creature whose result you replace glimmers with clockwork light until the effect ends. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
Patron · The Perfect Design

The Needle Sovereign

An occult patron of surgical elegance, social infiltration, and engineered precision through pain and ornament.
▸
Otherworldly Patron

The Perfect Design

A gestalt will born from collective obsession with flawless craft. Its warlocks become living needles: tailors of flesh, jewel-smiths of fate, and occult artisans who rewrite reality one precise puncture at a time.

1st levelExpanded Spell List

Expanded Spell List

The patron of immaculate craft adds precision, warding, and fabrication rites to your spell list.

LevelSpell
1stAbsorb Elements
1stSanctuary
2ndSpike Growth
2ndEnhance Ability
3rdConjure Barrage
3rdGlyph of Warding
4thLeomund's Secret Chest
4thDeath Ward
5thSkill Empowerment
5thCreation
1st levelInvestigative chassis

Neophyte's Urge for Secrets

Perfection begins with audit, pattern recognition, and exact language.

You gain proficiency in Investigation and one skill of your choice from Arcana, History, or Religion. You also learn true strike; it counts as a warlock cantrip for you and does not count against your cantrips known.
1st levelCore implement

Cenobite's Gift

Your patron marks you as one of its needles.

You carry a pool of magical needles equal to your proficiency bonus. As a bonus action, you can manifest one in an empty hand. Once per turn, as part of an attack you make, you can shape a manifested needle into a dart, dagger, or suitable ammunition for a blowgun, bow, crossbow, or firearm. Hit or miss, that needle reappears in your hand at the end of your turn (or at your feet if no hand is free). As a bonus action, you can stow or recall any number of your needles to a pocket dimension.
6th levelTool identity

Court's Renowned Selection

Masterpiece craft is your social credential and your battlefield utility.

You gain proficiency with one tool from Calligrapher's Supplies or Painter's Supplies, one tool from Weaver's Tools or Leatherworker's Tools, and one tool from Tinker's Tools or Jeweler's Tools. As a bonus action, you can transform one manifested needle into any tool with which you gained proficiency through this feature; it remains in that form until you change it again.
10th levelFailure correction

Flawless Design

A failed roll is merely an unfinished draft.

When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet rolls a 1 on any die, you can use your reaction to expend one of your Hit Dice, roll it, and force a reroll of that die. The rerolled die gains a bonus equal to the number rolled on your expended Hit Die.
14th levelAbsolute poise

Beyond Perfection

At your apex, hesitation no longer distorts your intent.

You cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws.
Book II

Pact Boons

Each boon is treated here as an invocation district: a promise, a load-bearing fantasy, and a track of workings that sharpen it.
▸

Pact Boons — canonical shell

The Noosphere routes each boon through a short bespoke invocation suite. This page now treats the boons as stable districts of the codex, even when individual workings inside them are still being tuned.

Track❖ Pact of the TomeThe grimoire track favours stolen language, ritual elasticity, and invocations that make knowledge feel alive, hungry, and expensive.
Track⛓ Pact of the ChainThe familiar track centres on divided agency: scouting, sabotage, relay-casting, and bargains that let the servant become a witness.
Track⚔ Pact of the BladeThe weapon track sharpens threat geometry, duelling pressure, and invocations that turn a summoned armament into a sentence the battlefield must finish reading.
Track◈ Pact of the TalismanThe token track deals in rebound luck, carried vows, and invocations that let failure glance off the bearer and return marked for collection.

Implementation rule for the next codex pass: each boon should read as a complete play promise before its dedicated invocation rail is expanded.

Arcane Jewel

A working that unfastens sun-blanched the seam, then balances the gait against its echo. Read the print only if the print is willing.Any pact can carry this working — a stored spell drunk down to fund the trick.

Prerequisite. Pact of the Talisman feature, Mystic Arcanum (6th level), The Genie or The Archfey patron

Effect:

As an Action, you can expend one use of your Mystic Arcanum (6th level) to energize your talisman until you take a Long Rest. When its wearer expends a 4th level or lower spell slot to cast a spell, and the Talisman is energized, it can use its Reaction to treat the spell slot as a 5th-level spell slot instead, leaving the talisman no longer energized.
Design Audit★★··· ⚡⚡··· 🚨····

Closest Analogues ★★···

spell access: tool proficiency ribbon. Could outshine: nothing obvious if wording stays bounded.

Insight ⚡⚡···

Upside: adds a utility hook. Downside: 2 AM parse load. Mechanics: Action, None + None; Dynamics: nothing obvious if wording stays bounded; Aesthetic: pact expression. Power pressure is 2/5 because scope, cadence, action timing, and limiter were scored together.

Patch 🚨····

Minor cleanup only: tighten wording and preserve the existing limiter.

Verdict

Wording is unpolished but the underlying clause is conservative. Treat as a sketch — clean the prose, the math is fine.

Variants — patches that preserve the fantasy
Lean PolishTighten the wording; preserve the existing limiter. The audit flags only nit-level concerns.
Flavor SharpeningBolt the working to a single iconic sense (touch, sight, voice) so the printed text reads as cleanly as it plays.
Lens 52: EconomyLens 49: EleganceLens 34: Skill

Arcane Skin

Prerequisite. Pact of the Tome feature, proficiency with calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies

When you finish a Long Rest, you can imprint your entire Book of Shadows onto your body, becoming a living book. If you do, your Book of Shadows disappears as it is absorbed by your skin. Additionally, you can use your own body as a spellcasting focus, and you no longer need a free hand to perform somatic components.

Body Jewelry

Your talisman is implanted, not worn, and hardens into couture armor.Defense is ritual bodywork.

Prerequisite. The Perfect Design patron, Pact of the Talisman feature

Effect:

Over a short or long rest, after 1 hour of light activity as if concentrating, you can graft your talisman into a creature's skin. While worn this way, that creature's base AC becomes 13 + your Charisma modifier and it cannot benefit from armor. The talisman cannot be removed unless the wearer is unconscious or you remove it as an action.

Cenobite's Mantle

Sanctuary becomes a retaliatory blood-gold contract.Protection can be cashed out as damage.

Centenary Research

A working that unfastens copper-tasting the witness, then balances the choir against its echo. Read the print only if the print is willing.Any pact can carry this working — a stored spell drunk down to fund the trick.

Prerequisite. Pact of the Tome, proficiency in Arcana, 18th level

Effect:

When you learn this invocation, choose one magic item: tome of understanding, tome of leadership and influence, or tome of clear thought. Your Book of Shadows is treated as having the properties of the chosen item. Only you can use and benefit from its effect, and once used, it loses its properties.
Design Audit★★★·· ⚡⚡⚡·· 🚨🚨···

Closest Analogues ★★★··

Variants — patches that preserve the fantasy
Concentration TetherConvert the open-window effect into a concentration window. The decision to hold or drop is the limiter the print is missing.
Reaction TaxCost a reaction once per turn. Keeps cadence honest without removing the trick from the fantasy.
Hit-Die FuelSpend 1 Hit Die per activation; effect scales with rolled value. Returns the cost to a renewable but visible pool.

If the gemstone attempts to take control of its wearer, the wearer must make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC.

Variants — patches that preserve the fantasy
Concentration TetherConvert the open-window effect into a concentration window. The decision to hold or drop is the limiter the print is missing.
Reaction TaxCost a reaction once per turn. Keeps cadence honest without removing the trick from the fantasy.
Hit-Die FuelSpend 1 Hit Die per activation; effect scales with rolled value. Returns the cost to a renewable but visible pool.

Book V

Design

The ledger that keeps the print honest.
▸
Section

Patterns

What the corpus is doing right and where it strains.
▸

This board reflects an audit of the full 176-invocation set.

176Invocations
2.0Uniqueness
1.8Insight
9High Pressure
Pros

Strong variable exploration

The set explores existing 5e variables through patron gates, pact gates, Hit Dice, Exhaustion, conditions, and familiar forms.

Cons

High-tier replacement risk

9 cards score 4+ power pressure; 20 need urgent patching where high-level spells or absolute wording bypass scarcity.

Math

Scoring model

Power = scope + cadence + action timing + replacement risk - limiter. Mean power 1.8/5, mean patch urgency 2.1/5.

MDA

Predicted experience

Mechanics produce mastery/control fantasy; dynamics push toward forced movement, condition leverage, and spell-list optimization.
